entries.name: William Pitt the Younger
entries.summary: Pitt's India Act 1784 wale British PM; inhein un ke walid Pitt the Elder se alag yaad rakhein.
facts: 1784 ka India Act East India Company ke affairs par British government ki nigrani aur control se mutalliq tha.
24 saal ki umar mein PM bane; UK government unhein Britain ka youngest-ever PM kehti hai.

entries.name: Menachem Begin
entries.summary: 1978 ka Nobel Peace Prize Egypt ke Anwar Sadat ke saath share kiya; Begin Israel ke PM thay.
facts: Camp David Accords 1978 ko Menachem Begin, Anwar Sadat aur US President Jimmy Carter ki mediation ke saath jorein.
Ohday alag yaad rakhein: Begin = Prime Minister of Israel; Sadat = President of Egypt.

entries.name: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman

tenures.label: PM ka daur; presidential daur is se alag hai

entries.summary: Awami League, Six-Point Programme aur Agartala Case ke MCQs mein naam aata hai; baad mein Bangladesh ke PM aur President dono ohdon par rahe.
facts: 12 January 1972 ko Prime Minister ka ohda sambhala; 25 January 1975 ko President bane.
Bangladesh ke PM ke taur par 1972–1975 ko yaad rakhein; 1971 aur 1975 ke presidential daur ko is mein na milayein.

entries.name: Narendra Modi

tenures.label: Musalsal premiership; third term 2024 se, checked 21 October 2026

entries.summary: Broader exam reference: bank mein Ahmedabad ke Narendra Modi Stadium ke zariye naam aata hai; yeh linked sawal un ke PM tenure ka sawal nahi.
facts: Pehli baar 26 May 2014 ko Prime Minister ka halaf liya; teesri baar 9 June 2024 ko halaf liya.
21 October 2026 ko check ki gayi official PMO profile aur October 2026 report unhein India ka Prime Minister identify karti hain.

entries.name: Winston Churchill
entries.summary: Second World War ke British PM; Atlantic Charter ko Churchill aur US President Franklin D. Roosevelt ke saath yaad rakhein.
facts: 14 August 1941 ko Churchill aur Roosevelt ne Atlantic Charter ki joint declaration jari ki; yeh binding treaty nahi thi.
Do PM daur: 1940–1945 aur 1951–1955. Unhein 1953 ka Nobel Prize in Literature bhi mila.

entries.name: Jawaharlal Nehru
entries.summary: India ke pehle Prime Minister; Pakistan–India tareekh aur Indira Gandhi ke family relation wale MCQs mein naam aata hai.
facts: Motilal Nehru un ke walid aur Indira Gandhi un ki beti thin; Nehru Report ko walid Motilal ke naam se pehchanein.
15 August 1947 ko PM bane aur 27 May 1964 tak is ohday par rahe.

entries.name: Lal Bahadur Shastri
entries.summary: 1965 ki Pakistan–India jang aur Tashkent Declaration ke saath yaad rakhein.
facts: 10 January 1966: Tashkent Declaration mein India ki taraf se Shastri aur Pakistan ki taraf se President Ayub Khan thay.
Un ka PM daur 9 June 1964 se 11 January 1966 tha.

entries.name: Indira Gandhi
entries.summary: Jawaharlal Nehru ki beti; do alag dauron mein PM rahin. 1975 ki Emergency in ke pehle daur mein thi.
facts: Family link: Jawaharlal Nehru → Indira Gandhi.
India ki Internal Emergency 25 June 1975 se 21 March 1977 tak rahi.

entries.name: Morarji Desai
entries.summary: Pakistan ka Nishan-e-Pakistan milne wale Indian Prime Minister ke taur par yaad rakhein.
facts: 24 March 1977 ko PM ka halaf liya; 28 July 1979 tak ohday par rahe.
Bharat Ratna aur Nishan-e-Pakistan dono awards mile.

entries.name: Atal Bihari Vajpayee

tenures.label: 1998 aur 1999 ki hukoomaton ka musalsal daur

entries.summary: 1999 Lahore Declaration ke Indian PM; Pakistan ki taraf Nawaz Sharif thay.
facts: 1996 ka mukhtasar daur aur 1998–2004 ka musalsal daur alag yaad rakhein.
Lahore Declaration ko 1999, Nawaz Sharif aur Vajpayee ke saath jorein.

entries.name: James Ramsay MacDonald
entries.summary: Britain ke pehle Labour PM; Round Table Conference aur 1932 Communal Award mein in ka naam aata hai.
facts: Communal Award August 1932 mein announce hua.
Indian Round Table Conferences ke waqt British PM thay; un ki do premierships 1924 aur 1929–1935 thin.

entries.name: Margaret Thatcher
entries.summary: Mazeed exam comparison: Britain ki pehli khatoon PM, jinhein Iron Lady kaha jata hai.
facts: First female British PM = Margaret Thatcher; second female British PM = Theresa May.
1979–1990 ka daur Conservative Party ki hukoomat tha.

entries.name: David Cameron
entries.summary: 2016 Brexit referendum ke baad ohda chhora; un ke baad Theresa May PM banin.
facts: 2010 mein Conservative–Liberal Democrat coalition ki qiyadat ki.
13 July 2016 ko premiership Theresa May ko mili.

entries.name: Theresa May
entries.summary: David Cameron ke baad 13 July 2016 ko PM banin; Britain ki doosri khatoon PM thin.
facts: Brexit negotiations in ke daur ka bara siyasi mauzu tha.
24 July 2019 ko Boris Johnson ne un ki jagah ohda sambhala.

entries.name: Boris Johnson
entries.summary: 2019–2022 ke British PM; bank ka 2020 COVID-19 sawal isi daur se mutalliq hai.
facts: PM banne se pehle 2016–2018 mein UK Foreign Secretary thay.
Theresa May ke baad 24 July 2019 ko ohda sambhala.

entries.name: Mahathir Mohamad
entries.summary: Malaysia mein do door door dauron mein PM rahe; 2018 ki wapsi ko pehle 1981–2003 daur se alag yaad rakhein.
facts: Pehla daur 1981–2003 tha; doosra 2018–2020.
Official list mein un ke baad 2020–2021 mein Muhyiddin Yassin (Mahiaddin Yasin) aate hain.

entries.name: Muhyiddin Yassin (Mahiaddin Yasin)
entries.summary: Mahathir ke doosre daur aur Ismail Sabri ke darmiyan Malaysia ke PM thay.
facts: Sequence: Mahathir Mohamad → Muhyiddin Yassin → Ismail Sabri Yaakob.
Official Malaysian list mein naam Tan Sri Mahiaddin Yasin bhi likha milta hai.

entries.name: Ismail Sabri Yaakob
entries.summary: Malaysia ke 9th Prime Minister; in se pehle Muhyiddin Yassin thay.
facts: Muddat 2021–2022; ordinal MCQ ka jawab 9th hai.
Malaysia ke Parliament ke 2023 Royal Address mein bhi unhein ninth PM kaha gaya hai.

entries.name: Goh Chok Tong
entries.summary: Singapore ke doosre PM; Asia-Europe Meeting (ASEM) ke 1994 idea se inhein jorein.
facts: 28 November 1990 ko Lee Kuan Yew ki jagah PM bane.
ASEM ka idea 1994 mein Asia aur Europe ke rabtay barhane ke liye samne laye.

entries.name: António Guterres
entries.summary: UN mein jane se pehle Portugal ke PM thay; PM aur UN Secretary-General ke daur aapas mein na milayein.
facts: Portugal ke Prime Minister: 1995–2002.
UNHCR ke High Commissioner: June 2005–December 2015; phir 2017 mein UN Secretary-General bane.

entries.name: Giuseppe Conte

tenures.label: Conte I aur Conte II hukoomatein

entries.summary: Italy ke PM rahe; 2018–2021 mein do alag cabinets ki qiyadat ki.
facts: Conte I cabinet 1 June 2018 ko shuru hui; Conte II 5 September 2019 ko.
Italian ohday ka naam President of the Council of Ministers hai; yahi Prime Minister hota hai.

entries.name: Prayut Chan-o-cha
entries.summary: Thailand ke General Prayut; bank ka 2019 PM aur military-rank sawal in se mutalliq hai.
facts: Thai government ki official farewell report unhein 29th PM aur nau saal ki premiership se pehchanti hai.
2019 ki royal appointment aur policy statement mein un ka rank General diya gaya hai.

entries.name: Robert Mugabe
entries.summary: Zimbabwe mein pehle Prime Minister ka ohda sambhala, phir President bane; dono ohdon ke saal alag hain.
facts: Prime Minister: 1980–1987.
President: 1987–2017; PM wale sawal mein presidential muddat na likhein.

entries.name: Haider al-Abadi
entries.summary: Mosul ki 2017 azadi ke elan ke saath yaad rakhein; us waqt Iraq ke PM thay.
facts: 10 July 2017 ko Mosul mein Daesh/ISIL ke khilaf operation ki kamyabi ka elan kiya.
2014 mein PM bane; 2018 mein Adel Abdul Mahdi ne un ki jagah li.

entries.name: Tarique Rahman

tenures.label: 21 October 2026 ko official cabinet list se checked

entries.summary: 17 February 2026 ko Bangladesh ke PM ka halaf liya. Current-affairs jawab hamesha sawal ki tareekh ke saath yaad rakhein.
facts: 21 October 2026 ko check ki gayi PMO cabinet list mein PM Tarique Rahman darj hain.
Isi official list mein Cabinet Division, Defence aur Armed Forces Division un ke paas hain; bank ka August 2026 portfolio jawab Defence hai.

entries.name: Mohammed bin Salman

tenures.label: 20 October 2026 ki official report; checked 21 October 2026

entries.summary: Saudi Crown Prince ko 27 September 2022 ke royal order se Prime Minister muqarrar kiya gaya.
facts: Crown Prince aur Prime Minister do alag ohday hain, jo Mohammed bin Salman ke paas ikatthay hain.
20 October 2026 ki Saudi Press Agency cabinet report unhein Crown Prince and Prime Minister kehti hai.

entries.name: Sirimavo Bandaranaike (Sirima Ratwatte Dias)
entries.summary: Mazeed exam comparison: duniya ki pehli khatoon Prime Minister, 21 July 1960.
facts: World's first woman PM = Sirimavo Bandaranaike; pehli Muslim-majority state ki elected khatoon leader = Benazir Bhutto — yeh dono sawal alag hain.
Sri Lanka mein teen alag dauron mein PM rahin: 1960–1965, 1970–1977 aur 1994–2000.
